page_Accessibility.lead: We aim for this site to meet WCAG 2.2 at level AA. Here is what has been done so far, what we know falls short, and how to tell us about a problem.

sections.heading: What we have done
items: Every page sets its language, has a unique title, and uses header, nav, main and footer landmarks.
A skip link is the first thing you reach with the keyboard. It jumps straight to the main content.
Links and buttons show a visible focus outline, in both the light and the dark theme.
The phone menu says whether it is open or closed. Escape closes it and puts focus back on the menu button.
The theme switch is a real button with a name and a pressed state, and your choice overrides your system setting.
Page changes are announced to screen readers.
If your system asks for reduced motion, the page animations are switched off.
Decorative images have empty alt text, so screen readers skip them.

sections.heading: Known problems
items: Some large headings are sized with viewport units, so they may not grow as much as you expect when you zoom in.
The blog posts, social links and some buttons are placeholders that point nowhere.
A few labels are written straight into the pages and are not yet translated.

sections.heading: How we check
body: Automated unit tests cover the menu, the theme switch, keyboard focus and the footer legal links. There are no browser tests and no outside audit has been done.

sections.heading: Report a problem
body: If something on this site gets in your way, open an issue on GitHub. Say which page you were on and what you were trying to do.

page_Privacy.lead: This site has no accounts, no analytics and no cookies. Here is what your browser does share, and with whom.

sections.heading: What the site stores
body: If you use the dark theme switch, your choice is saved in your browser's local storage under the key vueuse-color-scheme. It never leaves your device. Clear your site data to remove it.

sections.heading: Hosting
body: Cloudflare serves the site from a Cloudflare Worker. As the host, Cloudflare may process standard request data, such as your IP address and browser user agent, to deliver pages and protect the service.

sections.heading: Other services your browser contacts
body: The blog page loads its sample photos from cdn.devdojo.com, so that service sees the same kind of request data when you open the blog. The fonts are bundled with the site and load from the same address as the pages.

sections.heading: Questions
body: There is no email address for this project. Ask questions on GitHub.
